description: Source code for job management in Mattermost, including job creation, status updates, cancellation, and error handling within the server's channels/jobs module.

classes.name: JobServer
classes.description: Main server struct managing job operations, metrics, and store interactions.

methods.name: JobLoggerFields
methods.description: Returns logger fields reflecting job metadata.

methods.name: CreateJob
methods.description: Creates and saves a new job.

methods.name: CreateJobOnce
methods.description: Creates and saves a job only once.

methods.name: _createJob
methods.description: Internal method to initialize a job with validation.

methods.name: GetJob
methods.description: Retrieves a job by ID.

methods.name: ClaimJob
methods.description: Claims a job for processing, updating its status.

methods.name: SetJobProgress
methods.description: Updates job progress and status.

methods.name: SetJobWarning
methods.description: Sets job status to warning.

methods.name: SetJobSuccess
methods.description: Marks job as successful and updates metrics.

methods.name: SetJobError
methods.description: Marks job as errored, logs error details, updates metrics.

methods.name: SetJobCanceled
methods.description: Cancels a job and updates metrics.

methods.name: SetJobPending
methods.description: Resets job status to pending.

methods.name: UpdateInProgressJobData
methods.description: Updates job data for in-progress jobs.

methods.name: HandleJobPanic
methods.description: Handles panics during job execution, logs stack trace, sets job error, then re-panics.

methods.name: RequestCancellation
methods.description: Requests cancellation of a job, updating status accordingly.

methods.name: CancellationWatcher
methods.description: Watches for cancellation requests and signals via channel.

methods.name: GenerateNextStartDateTime
methods.description: Calculates the next start time based on current time and scheduled start time.

methods.name: CheckForPendingJobsByType
methods.description: Checks if there are pending jobs of a specific type.

methods.name: GetJobsByTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs of a specific type and status.

methods.name: GetLastSuccessfulJobByType
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent successful (or warning for message export) job of a specific type.
